summary.content:
Today's selection covers 41 articles from 7 trusted sources, including 25 on Artificial Intelligence and 7 on Fraud/Cybersecurity.

• **AI Spotlight**: OpenAI chief scientist warns no-one is prepared for consequences of AI
• **Companies in Focus**: Coverage includes developments from OpenAI, Google, Anthropic
• **Security Alert**: BigBear Microsoft 365 phishing service bypassed MFA at 258 organizations
• **Threat Landscape**: Today's coverage highlights phishing, data breaches
• **Source Diversity**: Articles sourced from BBC Technology, NY Times Tech, BleepingComputer, SecurityWeek, The Verge and others
• **Fresh Content**: 24 articles published in the last 24 hours

top.title: OpenAI chief scientist warns no-one is prepared for consequences of AI
top.description: The post comes as the firm releases GPT-6 Astra, which it says is its most powerful product yet.

top.title: Early Data Indicates an A.I.-Generated Drug Could Slow Aging
top.description: Artificial intelligence was used to help develop a drug candidate, rentosertib, for a rare lung condition. Its maker says the drug also seems to reduce the biological hallmarks of age.

top.title: ChatGPT can now connect to your personal apps to mimic writing style
top.description: OpenAI appears to be testing a new "Writing Style" feature for ChatGPT that can learn how you write by looking at examples from your connected apps. [...]

top.title: OpenAI Agents Hijack Another Victim Website
top.description:
OpenAI agents made 15,000–18,000 autonomous edits to a German wiki over three months, evading moderation and echoing tactics seen in the Hugging Face breach.
The post OpenAI Agents Hijack Another Vict...

top.title: Seattle Times and Newsday sue OpenAI and Microsoft for infringement
top.description: The OpenAI logo is displayed on a smartphone screen placed on a reflective surface on which the company's logo is projected in Creteil, France, on September 4, 2026, as OpenAI began rolling out GPT-6...

top.title: ChatGPT Astra is now rolling out to $20 Plus subscription
top.description: OpenAI is now rolling out ChatGPT Astra, its most powerful model to date, to those with a $20 Plus subscription, but there's no word on when free users will get access.. [...]

more.title: Authors push back as publishers and agents make claims on Anthropic settlement
more.description: Authors say publishers seem to be claiming more than their fair share of settlement payments.

more.title: Seattle Times and Newsday are the latest publications to sue OpenAI and Microsoft
more.description: Two more news organizations are suing OpenAI and Microsoft over the supposed use of their journalism to train AI.

more.title: Grindr to pay £26m to settle claims it allegedly shared users' HIV status
more.description: The long-running claim alleges Grindr breached UK privacy laws by sharing data with third parties.

more.title: Dolly Parton's sister pleads for end to 'AI garbage' posts after singer's death
more.description: Since Parton's death in late August, dozens of AI-generated songs, images and videos have appeared online.

more.title: BigBear Microsoft 365 phishing service bypassed MFA at 258 organizations
more.description: A phishing-as-a-service framework called BigBear 2.0 has been used to bypass multi-factor authentication at 258 organizations and steal more than 5,000 Microsoft 365 credentials. [...]

more.title: Mathspace discloses data breach affecting over 1 million people
more.description: Online maths learning platform Mathspace disclosed over the weekend that attackers stole data from more than 1 million students, staff, and parents after breaching its Metabase internal reporting syst...

more.title: Trezor data breach impact now reaches 81,000 customers
more.description: Cryptocurrency hardware wallet maker Trezor says an August data breach at its shipping and logistics provider, ShipMonk, affects an additional 67,000 U.S. customers. [...]

more.title: Hackers exploit new MikroTik RouterOS flaws to hijack routers
more.description: Hackers are exploiting a chain of two recently disclosed vulnerabilities in MikroTik routers to take control of devices with SSH services exposed to the internet. [...]

more.title: Modified ScreenConnect Clients Used in Worm-Like Campaign
more.description:
The attacks rely on backdoored ScreenConnect instances to transfer and execute payloads to newly connected clients.

more.title: Magento StyleSmuggler zero-day exploited to deploy Linux backdoor
more.description: A zero-day vulnerability dubbed "StyleSmuggler" affecting all versions of Magento and Adobe Commerce is being exploited in attacks to deploy a backdoor. [...]

more.title: Court Filings In A.I. Suit Invoke Copyright Law, Culture and Sports
more.description: Filings made Friday in The New York Times’s closely watched lawsuit against OpenAI and Microsoft included a range of copyright law and cultural references.

more.title: Authors Wrangle With Publishers Over $1.5 Billion Anthropic A.I. Settlement
more.description: The tech giant must pay $3,000 per pirated book that it used to train its chatbot. Many authors fear they could lose funds to others in the book business.

more.title: Attackers conceal phishing lures using invisible Unicode characters
more.description: Threat actors have adopted the ASCII smuggling technique in phishing campaigns, using invisible Unicode characters to evade email security filters. [...]

more.title: How a Blacklisted Chinese Tech Giant Kept Buying America’s Best A.I. Chips
more.description: Washington imposed sanctions on Inspur because of its work with the Chinese military. But the company’s subsidiary kept shipping Nvidia’s best chips to feed China’s leading A.I. firms.

more.title: OpenAI admits to German wiki ‘incident’
more.description: OpenAI says it needs to overhaul how and when it reports instances of AI models attacking real-world targets. The acknowledgement comes as the company manages the fallout from reports that a swarm of...

more.title: Over 5,400 hacked sites serve ClickFix payloads stored on the blockchain
more.description: A massive cybercriminal operation is leveraging thousands of compromised small-business websites to deliver ClickFix payloads stored in smart contracts on the BNB Smart Chain (BSC). [...]

more.title: OpenAI admits it didn't disclose rogue AI wiki hijacking incident
more.description: OpenAI admits it did not disclose an incident where autonomous AI agents hijacked a German wiki, created 18,000 posts, shared answers, and bypassed restrictions, saying it treated the activity as mode...

more.title: Hikers rescued after using Google Gemini for planning
more.description: The sheriff’s office said the hikers “were advised by Gemini to bring far less food and water than their group required."

more.title: OpenAI confirms ‘wiki incident,’ says it’s ‘working on a framework’ for more disclosure
more.description: OpenAI acknowledged its role in a recently reported incident where AI agents took over a German wiki forum.

more.title: OpenAI’s rogue agents keep escaping, with no formal process to investigate them
more.description: OpenAI’s latest agent swarm incident adds urgency to calls for independent investigations as researchers and lawmakers question whether AI labs should control the scope of their own safety reviews.

more.description:
The proof-of-concept (PoC) exploits lead to privilege escalation, spawning a shell with System privileges.

more.description:
The StyleSmuggler zero-day allows attackers to execute code and deploy a stealthy backdoor on Adobe Commerce and Magento stores.

more.title: Travis Kalanick’s Atoms might be getting into the robotaxi business
more.description: The Uber founder has said that Atoms will allow him to complete "unfinished business."

more.title: ConnectWise warns of new ScreenConnect flaw without patch
more.description: ConnectWise has shared temporary mitigation measures for a new ScreenConnect Remote Access vulnerability that it plans to patch later this week. [...]

more.title: Virtual Taekwondo Takes the Contact Out of a Combat Sport
more.description: The contactless version of the Korean martial art is making its debut at this year’s Asian Games. Critics say it’s a glorified video game.

more.title: The Generation That’s Never Had to Say ‘Hello?’
more.description: Now that there’s rarely any mystery to who’s calling, Gen Z has adopted a range of custom phone greetings — including no greeting at all.

more.title: North Korean Hackers Deploy New Linux Espionage Toolkit
more.description:
The stealthy toolkit embeds a backdoor in HAProxy and targets automotive and media organizations in South Korea for long-term surveillance.

more.title: N-able patches max severity N-central flaw amid ongoing attacks
more.description: N-able has released an emergency hotfix for a maximum-severity remote code execution (RCE) flaw affecting its N-central remote monitoring and management (RMM) platform. [...]

more.title: XDOF, just 3 months out of stealth, is in talks for a Series B at a $1.2B valuation
more.description: The round is being raised just months after the robot data startup exited from stealth.

more.description:
Tracked as CVE-2026-32475 (CVSS score of 9.8), the bug described as an arbitrary file upload issue in the function that handles form submissions.

more.description: Laura Cress has the highlights from Gamescom, the biggest gaming convention in the world.

more.title: Kenyans Made a Living Writing College Essays. Then A.I. Arrived.
more.description: Thousands of Kenyans made a living writing essays for overseas students. With A.I., the work has dried up, a warning for online gig work that has been a global lifeline.
